Name: Vanilla Radial Menu
Author: ragdez212121
Description:
[center][size=6][b][color=#f4b41b]Vanilla Radial Menu[/color][/b][/size]
[i]Fluid, ConcernedApe-styled wooden radial wheel with Bullet-Time & Full Backpack Quick-Switching[/i]
[size=2][b]English & Español Included[/b] • [b]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/b] • [b]Mouse & Controller Support[/b][/size][/center]

[line]

[size=5][b][color=#f4b41b]Overview[/color][/b][/size]
Tired of cycling through 3 backpack rows just to reach your Pickaxe, Scythe, Bombs, or Food in Skull Cavern?
[b]Vanilla Radial Menu[/b] adds a buttery-smooth, pixel-art 8-slot wooden radial wheel crafted to look and feel 100% native to Stardew Valley. Hold a single button, flick in any direction while the world slows into smooth [b]Bullet-Time[/b] (and the day clock pauses!), and release to equip any tool or item from [b]anywhere in your 36-slot backpack[/b].

[size=5][b][color=#f4b41b]Key Features[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]100% Authentic Vanilla Pixel-Art Aesthetic:[/b] Hand-crafted warm oak wheel, riveted brass center medallion, golden spotlight aura, native wooden tooltip boxes, item stack counts, and vanilla UI sound effects.[/*]
[*][b]Bullet-Time Slow Motion + Frozen Day Clock:[/b] Opening the wheel smoothly slows down monsters, projectiles, and world movement (20% speed by default) while [b]completely stopping the in-game day clock[/b] so you never waste precious minutes choosing an item. Meanwhile, the radial UI stays at crisp real-time 60+ FPS.[/*]
[*][b]Instant Flick & Release (Hold or Toggle):[/b] Hold [b]Q[/b] (or [b]Middle Mouse[/b] / [b]Right Stick[/b] on controller), flick toward one of the 8 wedges, and release to equip immediately—even mid-sword swing! Release inside the brass center hub or press [b]Esc / Right-Click[/b] to cancel.[/*]
[*][b]Full 36-Slot Backpack Reach:[/b] Equip tools, weapons, food, or placeables even if they are sitting in Row 2 or Row 3 of your backpack.[/*]
[*][b]Zero-Setup Smart Auto-Fill + Custom Pinning:[/b] Works out of the box by automatically populating Ring 1 with your primary weapon, tools, and hotbar items. Press [b]R[/b] ([b]Y[/b] on gamepad) while the wheel is open to enter [b]Edit Mode[/b] and pin any item from your backpack to any wedge![/*]
[*][b]Upgrade-Smart Slots:[/b] Upgraded your Copper Pickaxe at Clint's? Your pinned slot automatically recognizes the upgraded tool.[/*]
[*][b]Up to 4 Radial Rings (32 Slots):[/b] Scroll the [b]Mouse Wheel[/b], press [b]Tab[/b], [b]1–4[/b], or [b]LB / RB[/b] while open to flip between multiple radial rings.[/*]
[*][b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM) Ready:[/b] Customize keybinds, hold vs. toggle mode, slow-motion speed, clock freeze, wheel scale, animation speed, and more directly in-game.[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b][color=#f4b41b]Default Controls[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Hold Q / Middle Mouse / Right Stick:[/b] Open Radial Wheel (release to equip highlighted slot)[/*]
[*][b]Left-Click / Controller A:[/b] Equip highlighted slot immediately[/*]
[*][b]Right-Click / Esc / Controller B (or release in center):[/b] Cancel without switching[/*]
[*][b]Mouse Wheel / Tab / 1–4 / LB & RB:[/b] Switch Radial Ring (Page 1–4)[/*]
[*][b]R / Controller Y (while wheel is open):[/b] Toggle [b]Edit Mode[/b] (Left-Click wedge to pick from backpack • Right-Click wedge to clear)[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[center][size=5][b][color=#f4b41b]Español — Descripción[/color][/b][/size][/center]
[b]Vanilla Radial Menu[/b] añade una rueda radial fluida de 8 ranuras con estética pixel-art 100 % fiel al estilo nativo de Stardew Valley (madera cálida, centro de bronce, aura dorada y carteles originales).

[list]
[*][b]Cámara Lenta + Reloj Detenido:[/b] Al abrir la rueda, el mundo y los enemigos se ralentizan suavemente (20 % por defecto) y [b]el reloj del día se detiene por completo[/b] para que no pierdas ni un segundo eligiendo herramienta, mientras el menú responde a 60+ FPS reales.[/*]
[*][b]Cambio Rápido desde Toda la Mochila:[/b] Mantén [b]Q[/b] (o [b]Clic Central[/b] / [b]Stick Derecho[/b]), apunta hacia una dirección y suelta para equipar al instante objetos incluso de la fila 2 o 3 de tu inventario.[/*]
[*][b]Autorrelleno + Modo Edición (R):[/b] Funciona automáticamente sin configurar nada, o presiona [b]R[/b] con la rueda abierta para fijar cualquier objeto de tu mochila en cualquiera de los 4 anillos disponibles.[/*]
[*][b]Soporte completo para Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b] con textos en Español e Inglés.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b][color=#f4b41b]Installation / Instalación[/color][/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [b]SMAPI[/b] (4.0+ for Stardew Valley 1.6+).[/*]
[*][i](Optional)[/i] Install [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] to customize settings in-game.[/*]
[*]Extract
[code]VanillaRadialMenu[/code]into your
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]folder (or install via Vortex / Stardrop).[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI and hold [b]Q[/b]![/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b][color=#f4b41b]Compatibility[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley [b]1.6+[/b] (Windows, macOS, Linux, Steam Deck).[/*]
[*]Works with keyboard + mouse and all XInput / Switch / Steam Deck controllers.[/*]
[*]In multiplayer with remote players connected, world slow-motion and clock freeze automatically stay passive to prevent network desync while radial quick-switching remains fully active.[/*]
[/list]
